evidence.quote: The disagreement between our highly star-forming galaxies and the PRFM model is therefore not resolved by using this new formalism.

limitations_admitted.value: No HI measurement; Sigma_HI fixed at 7 Msun pc^-2

evidence.loc: 4.4 The Resolved Dynamical Equilibrium Pressure Relation
evidence.quote: In the absence of a measurement of $\Sigma_{HI}$, we assume a fixed value of $\Sigma_{HI}$ = 7 M$_{\odot}$ pc$^{-2}$

limitations_admitted.value: Fixed alpha_CO is almost certainly incorrect

evidence.loc: 5.3.2 Assumption of a fixed CO-to-H2 conversion factor
evidence.quote: This is almost certainly an incorrect assumption

limitations_admitted.value: Measured CO velocity dispersions are upper limits for the vertical dispersion (rotation not removed)

evidence.loc: 5.3.3 Assumption of a fixed gas velocity dispersion
evidence.quote: since we have not modelled and removed disk rotation, these velocity dispersions represent an upper limit to the possible value of $\sigma_{gas,z}$

limitations_admitted.value: Unresolved clumping may lead to an underestimate of P_DE

evidence.loc: 4.4 The Resolved Dynamical Equilibrium Pressure Relation
evidence.quote: the impact of sub-structure may lead to an under-estimate of $P_{DE}$ in the ALMaQUEST data

referee_caveats_inferred: alpha_CO appears as both 4.3 and 4.35 in the text; unclear which is used for the integrated masses
Inclination correction using b/a for all surface densities is uncertain for mergers and face-on galaxies
Constant Sigma_HI, sigma_gas,z and R_star/H_star shift P_DE together with Sigma_star and Sigma_H2, so part of the rPDE tightness may be built in
Random forest importances depend on the chosen feature set and the P_DE feature contains Sigma_star and Sigma_H2 by construction
Cycle 7 and earlier data are processed with different proposals and depths; uniformity of CO S/N>3 selection across the sample is not shown

data_public_as_stated.value: Spaxel-level table (Sigma_SFR, Sigma_star, Sigma_H2) released with the paper

evidence.quote: The data used in this paper are all released in a supplementary table in the electronic version of this paper.

we provide a public release of the star formation rate, stellar mass and molecular gas surface densities for all star-forming spaxels in the extended sample of 66 galaxies to permit a reproduction of these relations

missing_for_reproduction: Raw ALMA calibration and imaging recipe (deferred to Lin et al. 2020 and Thorp et al. 2022)
ODR and broken power-law fitting code and error treatment
Inputs for the Krumholz et al. (2018) curves (orbital times, Q)
Per-spaxel velocity dispersions and metallicities used in robustness tests are not stated as released
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Five ALMA projects of 66 CO(1-0) cubes; raw plus products likely tens of GB, but the released spaxel table (about 20,000 rows) suffices for the main analysis
reproducibility.score_reason: Spaxel-level table is public and the P_DE, fitting and comparison recipe is mostly given, but ALMA processing is inherited from earlier papers and random forest and fitting details are missing.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: The derived spaxel table is released and the main results (ODR fits, scatter, broken power law break at 4.528, P_DE formula with fixed Sigma_HI and sigma) are numeric; the random forest ranking is only reproducible qualitatively.

methods_papers.why: Describes ALMaQUEST sample and ALMA acquisition and processing for the original 46 galaxies
Describes the Cycle 7 merger observations and identical processing
Appendix B gives the random forest methodology

companion_papers.why: Earlier random forest analysis of Sigma_H2 and Sigma_star
